name: DeviceExample

expect.contains:
DeviceExample.ino
A simple demonstration of TinyGPSPlus with an attached GPS module
Testing TinyGPSPlus library v. 1.1.0
by Mikal Hart

Location: 48.117298,11.516668  Date/Time: 10/18/2026 12:00:01.00

description: TinyGPSPlus's DeviceExample, unmodified, reading the NEO-6M through SoftwareSerial at 4800 baud: each valid sentence (seven a second) prints the location, date and time. The module, hot-started, has its fix at the first burst (12:00:01 UTC); after it moves across Munich at 1.5 s the 12:00:02 burst carries the new place. The coordinates print as the Uno's 32-bit floats make them (48.117298 for the 48.1173 sent as 4807.03800), checked against TinyGPS's parsing and Print's rounding computed independently.
